purpose: Teach: 女児/インサイダー/安保理/郵政省/運輸省/建設省/日本共産党/中共

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、女児の発達検査を医療チームで丁寧におこないます
lines.en: Ren, our medical team will conduct the developmental assessment for the child with careful attention to detail.
lines.style: Clear, steady opening. Professional but warm — this is reassurance wrapped in competence. Measured pace, slight emphasis on 'careful.' No performance, just presence.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医薬品のインサイダー情報を医療チームで厳格に管理します
lines.en: Yes, we manage all pharmaceutical information with strict protocols within our medical team.
lines.style: Direct and calm. A slight nod in the voice — acknowledging the reasonable concern. Unhurried. The tone of someone who takes responsibility seriously without needing to announce it.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、安保理決議に基づくWHOガイドラインを医療チームで参考にします
lines.en: Ren, we also consult WHO guidelines in our medical team's approach to this case.
lines.style: Even, informative delivery. No change in tone — just laying out the facts clearly. Steady breath. Professional but not distant. The voice of someone used to explaining things without oversimplifying.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 旧郵政省時代の郵送カルテも、貴院、保管されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital does keep those older postal service records too, don't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Quiet, slightly curious inflection on the question. Not accusatory — genuinely interested in understanding how things work. Hesitant pause before 'don't you,' like he's checking that it's okay to ask. Respectful distance.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、旧運輸省管轄の救急体制を医療チームが活用します
lines.en: Yes, our medical team utilizes the emergency protocols that were established under the old transportation ministry.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact. No defensive edge. Simply confirming what is — the way you'd explain an old building's foundation. Steady. No apology in the voice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、旧建設省管轄の病院施設を医療チームで維持します
lines.en: Yes, we maintain the hospital facilities that were transferred from the old construction ministry oversight.
lines.style: Same register as before — administrative, clear. Slight fatigue underneath, not from emotion but from the weight of institutional responsibility. Still steady. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 日本共産党系の市民医療相談を、貴院、対応されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital does respond to citizen medical consultation requests from community organizations, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Same careful tone as his earlier question. Gentle. Testing slightly, but not confrontationally — more like he's checking how the pieces fit. Respectful. Small pause before the final question tag.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、中共との医療交流プログラムにも医療チームで参加します
lines.en: Yes, our medical team also participates in medical exchange programs with international partners.
lines.style: Unruffled. Even delivery, same composure as throughout. No hesitation, no emphasis. Just stated as fact. Breath steady. The voice of someone who has answered harder questions without breaking stride.
